versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Colorado Pride POD Prompt Pack.
- Provides structured design prompts for Colorado-themed and Sasquatch/cryptid print-on-demand products.
- Optimized for use with Midjourney, DALL-E 3, or Canva.
- Includes commands for generating and customizing high-conversion merch prompts.
- Built-in guidelines to avoid copyrighted logos and focus on vector-style designs.
